tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page with HTML body content (DO NOT include <script> tags in body - use scripts parameter instead). Returns a URL and page ID for future updates.

body.description: HTML content for the page body (ONLY the inner content, NO <script> tags here)

scripts.description: Optional array of JavaScript scripts to include in the page. Each script must have EITHER src OR content property.

items.description: Script object with either src property (for external scripts) OR content property (for inline scripts)

content.description: Content for inline script (JavaScript code without <script> tags)

stylesheets.description: Optional array of CSS stylesheets to include in the page

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update an existing page with new HTML body content (DO NOT include <script> tags in body - use add_scripts function instead). Requires the page ID from a previous create_page call. This will extend the page's expiration time.

id.description: ID of the page to update (obtained from the create_page response)

body.description: New HTML content for the page body (ONLY the inner content, NO <script> tags here)

tools.name: destroy_page
tools.description: Remove a page by ID. This permanently deletes the page and all associated content (HTML, scripts, stylesheets). This action cannot be undone.

id.description: ID of the page to destroy (obtained from a previous create_page response)

tools.name: add_scripts
tools.description: Add JavaScript scripts to an existing page. This is the CORRECT way to add or update scripts after page creation. This will extend the page's expiration time.

id.description: ID of the page to add scripts to (obtained from a previous create_page response)

scripts.description: Array of JavaScript scripts to add to the page. Each script must have EITHER src OR content property.

items.description: Script object with either src property (for external scripts) OR content property (for inline scripts)

content.description: Content for inline script (JavaScript code without <script> tags)

tools.name: add_stylesheets
tools.description: Add CSS stylesheets to an existing page. This is the CORRECT way to add or update styles after page creation. This will extend the page's expiration time.

id.description: ID of the page to add stylesheets to (obtained from a previous create_page response)

stylesheets.description: Array of CSS stylesheets to add to the page. Each stylesheet must have the href property.

items.description: Stylesheet object with href property for external CSS file
